data.text: Shipped as DEC-50. The plan's scratch-copy numbers (stemming 37→43 first place) did not reproduce on the held-out set: first place 27→26, while top-3 33→38 and top-5 35→40. On 15 off-topic developer questions stemming takes confidently-wrong answers from 2 to 4, all at coverage 0.40-0.44 (flagged as partial). Silence at 0.45 would make that 0/15 at a cost of 2 first places and 2 top-three answers — rejected, but it is the owner's lever if near-misses matter more than recall. The three nonsense queries in the relevance test and the prompt hook stay silent. Search 140-160 ms end to end, 32 ms a query in-process. Full suite 1309 green.
